item.description:
Probation | Public Comment on Contract Awards | Notice

This is a notice that the New York City Department of Probation (DOP) is seeking comments from the public regarding the proposed four (4) contract awards described below.

Contract Type: General Contract (CT1)

Scope of Services: To support the continuation of services under the Plus+ Mentoring Program (ICM). The Plus+ Mentoring Program (ICM) is a mentoring intervention designed for justice-involved youth under intensive community monitoring or high-risk supervision by DOP. The program provides structured mentoring and skill-building activities aimed at strengthening emotional regulation, improving decision-making, and promoting pro-social behavior. Participants receive weekly group sessions and one-on-one mentoring from trained community mentors, with an increased emphasis on sustained engagement between youth and their families. Services will be provided throughout New York City.

Contract Term: January 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027
